title: Immunohistology to Confirm ChR2 Expression in Mouse Brain Slices
author: Mai-Anh Vu

steps.title: Remove Lugol’s solution
steps.instruction: Soak the implanted brains in 5 % sodium thiosulfate (STS) prepared in 1 % PBS for 4–6 days to remove Lugol’s solution.

steps.title: Remove implant and re‑soak
steps.instruction: Remove the implant, then return the brain to the same STS solution for an additional 1 hour.

steps.title: Cryoprotect in sucrose
steps.instruction: Transfer the brains to a solution of 30–40 % sucrose in PBS and keep until the brains sink (cryoprotection).

steps.title: Section brain tissue
steps.instruction: Slice coronal sections 50 µm thick using a Leica CM3050 S cryostat and place the sections into PBS for storage.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate the sections in 5 % normal goat serum (NGS) and 0.2 % PBS‑Triton (PBST) solution (duration as desired, typically ~1 h at room temperature).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections for 24–48 h at 4 °C in a solution containing 5 % NGS, 0.2 % Triton, and GFP primary antibody diluted 1:1000.

steps.title: Wash sections
steps.instruction: Wash the sections (e.g., rinse with PBS) to remove unbound primary antibody.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections for 2 h at room temperature in 5 % NGS, 0.2 % PBST, and Alexa™ 488 secondary antibody diluted 1:200.

steps.title: Mount sections
steps.instruction: Mount the stained sections onto glass slides using Vectashield Mounting Medium.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Capture images of the mounted sections with an Olympus VS120 slide scanner.
